submitted.rationale: Index 12 (Ni 0.61, Sb 0.39) had the highest measured EQE, 0.289%. Index 8 (Ni 0.73) gave 0.111% and index 21 (Ni 0.34) gave 0.005%, so EQE peaks at intermediate Ni-rich compositions. XRD shows trirutile NiSb2O6 across the whole line. A separate Sb-oxide phase appears at the Sb-rich end (idx 28), and a weak NiO-like peak (Q≈3.0) appears at idx 4.
